verdict.rationale: Asaas has a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages for payments (asaas-docs-14, asaas-docs-15, asaas-docs-18). Its docs state that tests can be run directly from that reference against the Sandbox environment (asaas-docs-5), which is backed by a documented sandbox for safe trial flows (asaas-docs-6). Interactivity rests on that single sentence, though. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the try-it console and its generated code samples, and independent or hands-on confirmation that requests actually run from the reference.
